claim.quote: we show that the addition of the charge readout analysis to the CCD allows us too obtain a statistics-limited 90% C.L. upper limit on the $e^-$ rejection factor of $5.6\times10^{-6}$ for recoils with energies between 40 and 200 keV$_{\mathrm{ee}}$

key_value.note: 90% CL upper limit on the electron rejection factor (fraction of electrons passing), 40-200 keVee.
key_value.quote: $5.6\times10^{-6}$ for recoils with energies between 40 and 200 keV

name: Background Rejection in the DMTPC Dark Matter Search Using Charge Signals

summary.plain: Adding charge signals to the camera images let DMTPC show that electron backgrounds are rejected at a level of about one in 180,000 for recoils between 40 and 200 keV.
summary.technical: Charge readout plus CCD: statistics-limited 90% CL upper limit on the electron rejection factor of 5.6e-6 for 40-200 keVee recoils; CCD/charge coincidence reduces CCD-specific backgrounds by more than two orders of magnitude.

title: Background Rejection in the DMTPC Dark Matter Search Using Charge Signals
why_it_matters: It shows the surface-run backgrounds could be reduced with the combined readout.
